text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Foreign minister says Iraqi oil to reach international markets soon.
- Foreign minister says Iraq is trying to close file on long range missile as soon as possible.
- U.S. oil expert says Iraq has key to meeting world demand for oil.
- International oil overseers to arrive in Iraq soon.
- Group of U.S. citizens to hold hunger strike in Baghdad to protest against U.N. sanctions on Iraq.
(Above also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Oil ministry starts signing deals with foreign firms to sell oil under partial sales agreement with U.N.
- Central Bank governor says surge in value of Iraqi dinar has prompted Iraqis to boost their dinar savings.
